items.title_en: Route Anything: A Study of Model and Policy Routing for General-Purpose AI Systems
items.title_zh: Route Anything：通用人工智能系统中模型与策略路由的研究
items.abstract_en: Artificial general intelligence (AGI) requires a method that can understand, generate, reason, and act across diverse domains and modalities. Rather than relying on a single model to master every capability, a promising path toward AGI now is to orchestrate a heterogeneous ecosystem of specialized models, tools, and policies (candidates) into a unified AI system. At the heart of this vision lies a fundamental question: how can an AI system dynamically select and coordinate the most capable candidate for each task while balancing performance and computational cost? In this work, we present Route Anything, a unified framework for studying model and policy routing across general-purpose AI systems. We develop a unified theoretical foundation that characterizes optimal routing under quality--cost trade-offs and establishes how the information available to a router determines its attainable performance. To systematically investigate routing across diverse capabilities, we first construct an omni-modal trajectory matrix spanning 25 benchmarks across language understanding, image, video, and speech generation, coding and workplace agents, and robotic manipulation, comprising 374,401 scored runs from 452 candidate configurations. Building on this framework, we train and test different routers to investigate the potential of omni-modal model routing, the capabilities of learned routers, and the conditions under which routing improves efficiency. Our results reveal substantial opportunities for capability orchestration: per-input oracle routing outperforms the best fixed candidate by 5.4 points, and learned routers outperform it by 0.3 points across 16 benchmarks, by 2.1 points on video generation, and by 1.1 points on robot manipulation while using 24% less policy time. More importantly, routing raises efficiency by 8.82x on average compared with the reference model.
items.abstract_zh: 通用人工智能（AGI）需要能在多领域、多模态间理解、生成、推理与行动的方法。与其依赖单一模型掌握所有能力，一条更有前景的路径是把专业模型、工具与策略（候选）组成的异构生态编排为统一的 AI 系统。其核心问题是：系统如何为每个任务动态选择并协调最有能力的候选，同时兼顾性能与计算成本？本文提出 Route Anything——一个研究通用 AI 系统模型与策略路由的统一框架，建立了刻画质量—成本权衡下最优路由的理论基础，并阐明路由器可获得的信息如何决定其可达到的性能上限。为系统考察跨能力路由，我们构建了覆盖语言理解、图像/视频/语音生成、编程与办公智能体、机器人操作等 25 个基准的全模态轨迹矩阵，包含来自 452 个候选配置的 374,401 条带评分运行记录。基于该框架训练并测试多种路由器，考察全模态模型路由的潜力、学习型路由器的能力以及路由提升效率的条件。结果显示能力编排存在可观空间：逐输入的理想（oracle）路由比最佳固定候选高 5.4 分；学习型路由器在 16 个基准上高出 0.3 分，视频生成高出 2.1 分，机器人操作高出 1.1 分，同时策略耗时减少 24%。
items.highlight_zh: 构建 37 万余条轨迹的路由基准，证明动态路由优于单一最佳模型
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：通往 AGI 不一定非要训练一个无所不能的单一模型。更现实的思路是把众多专用模型、工具与策略当作“候选”，编排成一个统一系统，让系统按任务挑选最合适的那个。难点在于：如何在质量与计算成本之间取得平衡，并知道路由器究竟需要多少信息才能做出好选择。

方法：作者提出 Route Anything 框架。理论部分刻画了质量—成本权衡下的最优路由，并说明路由器可获取的信息量如何决定其性能上限。为做实证，他们构建了一个“全模态轨迹矩阵”：覆盖语言理解、图像/视频/语音生成、编程与办公智能体、机器人操作共 25 个基准，记录 452 个候选配置产生的 374,401 条带评分的运行结果，然后训练并比较不同路由器。

结果：如果能为每个输入完美挑选候选（oracle），得分比全局最佳固定候选高 5.4 分；而实际可学习到的路由器在 16 个基准上高出 0.3 分，视频生成高出 2.1 分，机器人操作高出 1.1 分，同时策略耗时减少 24%。

为何重要：它把“能力编排”从工程直觉变成可度量、可复现的研究对象，既给出理论边界，也给出大规模评测数据与经验证据，说明路由确实能带来实际收益，并为后续设计更好的路由器提供基准。

rm.usage: 讲的是为异构模型/工具做逐输入路由，与自瞄、导航等具体环节没有直接对应；最多可类比为哨兵在不同感知/决策模块间按算力与收益切换，但改造代价大、收益不明。

items.title_en: Behind Video Generation: Observations and Insights on Multimodal Understanding from Kling
items.title_zh: 视频生成背后：来自 Kling 的多模态理解观察与洞见
items.abstract_en: Video generation has progressed from isolated clips to coherent short-form audiovisual sequences, and the bottleneck is shifting from rendering to semantic control. This report summarizes the observations and insights on multimodal understanding gained from successive generations of Kling. We argue that generation quality is the projection of multimodal understanding through the entire data--conditioning--alignment--evaluation chain, and we examine this chain module by module. Kling-MLLM, a shared multimodal foundation model that unifies image, video, audio, synchronized audio--video, and interleaved inputs, is specialized for each downstream module. Because a DiT is trained on far fewer training samples than a language model, we treat captioning as a semantic contract that maximizes description density, and extend it to reference-grounded captioning that makes reference bindings explicit. Prompt enhancement translates user intent into this caption distribution: basic PE is derived from captions of compelling videos and refined with text-level and generator-in-the-loop reinforcement learning, while agentic PE refines the story and retrieves compelling examples. We show that a reliable text encoder comes from perceptual training rather than from stronger language ability, and that candidates can be screened from text alone before end-to-end training. Reward modeling pairs a general reward model for explainable, localized critiques with a decision reward model for fast multidimensional scoring, treating perceptual bandwidth as a first-class design parameter. Finally, we review task-specific automatic evaluation, focusing on protocols that expose scoring shortcuts and help trace failures to their upstream source. We hope these lessons offer practical guidance for building the understanding stack behind controllable video generation.
items.abstract_zh: 视频生成已从孤立片段发展到连贯的短时音视频序列，瓶颈正从画面渲染转向语义控制。本报告总结了在 Kling 多代模型迭代中获得的多模态理解观察与洞见。我们认为，生成质量是多模态理解在“数据—条件控制—对齐—评测”整条链路上的投影，并逐模块加以剖析。Kling-MLLM 是一个共享的多模态基础模型，统一处理图像、视频、音频、同步音视频与交错输入，并为各下游模块做专门化。由于 DiT 的训练样本远少于语言模型，我们将字幕视为最大化描述密度的“语义契约”，并扩展为显式标注引用绑定关系的引用落地字幕。提示增强把用户意图翻译进这一字幕分布：基础 PE 由优质视频字幕派生，并通过文本级与生成器在环的强化学习精修；智能体式 PE 则润色故事并检索优质示例。我们表明可靠文本编码器来自感知训练而非更强的语言能力，并可在端到端训练前仅凭文本筛选候选。奖励建模将用于可解释、局部化点评的通用奖励模型与用于快速多维打分的决策奖励模型配对，并把感知带宽视为一等设计参数。最后回顾任务专用自动评测，聚焦能暴露打分捷径、并帮助把失败追溯到上游来源的协议。
items.highlight_zh: 提出生成质量是多模态理解在数据到评测全链路上的投影
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：视频生成正从几秒钟的孤立片段走向带声音的连贯短片，真正的瓶颈已不再是“画得像不像”，而是“能不能精确控制内容”。作者想回答：多模态理解在视频生成中到底起什么作用、卡在哪里。

方法与观点：报告以 Kling 多代模型的实践为线索，把整条链路拆成四段——数据、条件控制、对齐、评测——逐段分析，主张生成质量本质上是多模态理解能力在这条链上的“投影”。具体做法包括：用统一的 Kling-MLLM 处理图像、视频、音频、同步音视频与交错输入；把字幕当作“语义契约”，追求最大描述密度，并提出能显式表达引用关系的引用落地字幕；提示增强把用户意图翻译成这种字幕分布，基础版由优质视频字幕派生并用强化学习精修，智能体版还能改写故事、检索范例。

关键发现：可靠的文本编码器来自感知训练，而非单纯更强的语言能力；因此在昂贵的端到端训练之前，可以仅凭文本筛选候选方案。奖励建模采用“通用奖励模型做可解释的局部点评 + 决策奖励模型做快速多维打分”的双轨设计，并把感知带宽当成一等设计参数。

为何重要：它把视频生成的工程经验上升为可复用的方法论，强调语义与评测协议的重要性，为构建更可控的生成系统提供实践指南。

rm.usage: 视频生成与多模态字幕/奖励建模的报告，与装甲板识别、能量机关击打等任务没有可落地的接口，关联很弱。

items.title_en: WebHarbor: Docking Real Websites for Evolving GUI Agent Environments
items.title_zh: WebHarbor：为可演化的 GUI 智能体环境对接真实网站
items.abstract_en: GUI web agents require realistic and interactive environments that remain stable during both evaluation and training. Live website evaluation suffers from changing content, access restrictions, and limited coverage of authenticated workflows, while existing synthetic environments for training often lack functional depth and visual fidelity. We propose WebHarbor, a suite of 153 executable and dockerized website environments that faithfully reconstruct the visual interfaces, content, and functional workflows of real-world web services under deterministic control. We build WebHarbor through task-driven human-agent collaboration, where environments evolve as new tasks expand their functional scope, coding agents implement the required changes, and human contributors audit visual fidelity, functional correctness, and task validity. The resulting suite comprises 3,518 tasks spanning multi-step and post-authentication workflows, where existing works often fail to cover. Beyond reliable evaluation, WebHarbor provides high-fidelity synthetic web environments for cost-efficient reinforcement learning (RL). We demonstrate that a Qwen 4B-level GUI agent trained with RL in WebHarbor generalizes to unseen tasks and performs competitively with leading open-source GUI web agents across four benchmarks. The code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/aiming-lab/WebHarbor.
items.abstract_zh: GUI 网页智能体需要既真实可交互、又在评测与训练期间保持稳定的环境。对真实在线网站的评测受内容变动、访问限制与需登录流程覆盖不足之困；而现有用于训练的合成环境往往缺乏功能深度与视觉保真度。我们提出 WebHarbor，一套包含 153 个可执行、容器化（dockerized）的网站环境，可在确定性控制下忠实重建真实网络服务的视觉界面、内容与功能流程。WebHarbor 通过任务驱动的人机协作构建：新任务扩展环境的功能范围，编码智能体实现所需改动，人类贡献者审核视觉保真度、功能正确性与任务有效性。最终套件包含 3,518 个任务，涵盖多步与登录后流程等现有工作常难以覆盖的场景。除可靠评测外，WebHarbor 还提供高保真合成网页环境用于低成本强化学习（RL）。我们展示，在 WebHarbor 中用 RL 训练的 Qwen 4B 级 GUI 智能体可泛化到未见任务，并在四个基准上与领先的开源 GUI 网页智能体表现相当。代码与数据已公开。
items.highlight_zh: 153 个容器化真实网站环境与 3518 个任务，支撑可复现训练与评测
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：训练网页 GUI 智能体需要真实、可交互、又不会“变来变去”的环境。直接拿真实网站来测，会遇到内容天天更新、访问受限、需要登录的流程覆盖不到等问题；而现成的合成环境又往往功能太浅、界面不够真，智能体学到的东西难以迁移。

方法：作者提出 WebHarbor，把真实网络服务重建为 153 个可执行、容器化的网站环境，界面、内容与功能流程都尽量忠实还原，并且完全在确定性控制之下，随时可复现。构建方式是“任务驱动的人机协作”：新任务不断扩展环境需要支持的功能，由编码智能体负责实现改动，人类贡献者则审核视觉保真度、功能正确性和任务本身是否合理。这样环境能随任务演化而成长。

结果：套件共包含 3,518 个任务，覆盖多步骤操作与登录后才能完成的流程——这恰是现有工作常覆盖不到的部分。除评测外，这些高保真环境还能低成本用于强化学习：一个 Qwen 4B 级别的 GUI 智能体在其中用 RL 训练后，能泛化到没见过的任务，并在四个基准上与领先的开源 GUI 网页智能体表现相当。

为何重要：它同时解决了“评测不可复现”和“训练环境不够真”两个痛点，并公开代码与数据，为 GUI 智能体研究提供了一个可共享、可持续扩展的基础设施。

rm.usage: 网页 GUI 智能体的容器化仿真环境，与 RoboMaster 的视觉、导航、决策任务无交集，关联很弱。

items.title_en: PrimeSim: A Generalist World Model Simulator from Large-Scale Cross-Embodiment Demonstrations
items.title_zh: PrimeSim：基于大规模跨具身演示的通用世界模型模拟器
items.abstract_en: A robot world model that serves as a simulator must do more than generate plausible videos: it must faithfully follow commanded actions, maintain consistency across camera views, and sustain coherent long-horizon rollouts. We present PrimeSim, an action-conditioned, multiview world model simulator that addresses these challenges through progressive midtraining and posttraining. Starting from a pretrained video generator, we midtrain on 30,110 hours of robot demonstrations spanning 22 platforms. To improve action following, we introduce a unified cross-embodiment action representation and frame-aligned dual-path conditioning to strengthen action-frame correspondence. To maintain multiview consistency, we develop view-aware interleaved attention with explicit camera identities, enabling cross-view information exchange while preserving view-specific representations. We further introduce a fast-video, slow-memory posttraining framework that transforms the bidirectional video generator into an efficient autoregressive simulator. By combining fast causal generation, self-rollout training, and hierarchical temporal memory, PrimeSim mitigates error accumulation from self-generated histories and supports coherent long-horizon simulation. PrimeSim runs at 10.1 FPS, remains stable over long-horizon rollouts on rigid and deformable manipulation tasks, and transfers to held-out platforms within 100 to 200 gradient steps where the pretrained backbone does not. Against five open-source action-conditioned world models it leads four of the five WorldSimProbe suites and posts the best overall EWMBench score, while fine-grained local calibration still trails the field; its rollouts are faithful enough to support GRPO-based policy optimization. We release the model weights, inference code, and training code.
items.abstract_zh: 作为模拟器的机器人世界模型不能只生成看似合理的视频，还必须忠实跟随指令动作、保持多相机视角间的一致性，并维持长时程推演连贯。我们提出 PrimeSim，一个动作条件化的多视角世界模型模拟器，通过渐进式中训练与后训练应对上述挑战。从预训练视频生成器出发，我们在覆盖 22 个平台、共 30,110 小时的机器人演示上做中训练。为提升动作跟随能力，我们引入统一的跨具身动作表示与帧对齐双路条件化，以强化动作与帧的对应关系。为保持多视角一致性，我们设计带显式相机标识的视角感知交错注意力，在保留各视角特有表示的同时实现跨视角信息交换。我们进一步提出“快视频、慢记忆”的后训练框架，把双向视频生成器转变为高效自回归模拟器。结合快速因果生成、自推演训练与层次化时间记忆，PrimeSim 缓解了自生成历史带来的误差累积，支持连贯的长时程模拟。PrimeSim 运行速度达 10.1 FPS，在刚体与可变形物体操作任务的长时程推演中保持稳定，并能在 100 至 200 步梯度内迁移到留出平台，而预训练骨干做不到这一点；在五个开源动作条件化世界模型中，它在 WorldSimProbe 五个套件中的四个领先，并取得最佳 EWMBench 总体分数，但细粒度局部校准仍落后于领域水平；其推演足够忠实，可支撑基于 GRPO 的策略优化。我们公开模型权重与推理代码。
items.highlight_zh: 跨 22 平台 3 万小时演示训练，实现 10.1 FPS 稳定长时程机器人模拟
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：要让机器人世界模型真正当“模拟器”用，光生成像样的视频远远不够。它必须严格听从给定的动作指令，多个相机视角之间不能自相矛盾，而且推演得足够久还不崩坏（不累积漂移）。这三点恰恰是现有视频生成模型最难做到的。

方法：PrimeSim 从预训练视频生成器出发，分阶段改造。中训练用 22 个机器人平台、共 30,110 小时的演示数据。为让生成画面紧跟动作，作者设计了统一的跨具身动作表示，加上帧对齐的双路条件化，强化“哪个动作对应哪一帧”。为保持多视角一致，用带显式相机标识的视角感知交错注意力，既交换跨视角信息，又保留各视角自身特征。后训练提出“快视频、慢记忆”框架：把原本双向的视频生成器改造成自回归模拟器，结合快速因果生成、用自己生成的历史做自推演训练，以及层次化时间记忆，从而抑制误差累积。

结果：运行速度 10.1 FPS；在刚体与可变形物体操作的长时程推演中保持稳定；迁移到留出平台只需 100–200 步梯度，而原预训练骨干无法迁移。与五个开源动作条件化世界模型相比，它在 WorldSimProbe 的五个套件中四个领先，EWMBench 总体分最高，但细粒度局部校准仍有差距。其推演足够可信，可用于 GRPO 强化学习优化策略。

为何重要：它把视频生成模型真正推向可用的机器人模拟器，并公开权重与推理代码，为用模拟做机器人训练提供了新基座。

rm.usage: 动作条件化多视角世界模型模拟器，可作为一种替代/补充仿真手段，为哨兵导航、工程机械臂操作等生成带动作条件的长时程推演数据用于策略训练；但该模型针对机械臂操作，需先迁移到 RM 场景与相机配置。

items.title_en: RoboTryOn: Synthesizing Dexterous Robot Demonstrations from Human Videos via Virtual Try-On
items.title_zh: RoboTryOn：通过虚拟试穿从人类视频合成灵巧机器人演示
items.abstract_en: Robot foundation models have shown remarkable performance in robot control, yet adapting them to a new task still relies heavily on teleoperated demonstrations. Egocentric human videos offer a scalable substitute, but overlaying rendered robots on human videos or retargeting human poses into robot actions leaves significant visual or action gaps for high-DoF robot embodiments. To address this limitation, we propose RoboTryOn, which treats human-to-robot translation as virtual try-on: try-on keeps the person and swaps the garment, RoboTryOn keeps the demonstrated motion and swaps the human for the robot. Specifically, RoboTryOn converts a human video into a video of the target robot specified by a reference image, while preserving the original task, objects, and background. To maintain visual consistency, we translate selected keyframes autoregressively and use them to guide video synthesis with motion conditioned on the human hand skeleton. Additionally, we use an inverse dynamics model (IDM) that incorporates depth features to infer action labels from synthesized videos for policy learning. Our experiments across multiple humanoid embodiments show that policies trained with our synthetic data improve the average success rate on novel tasks, including challenging bimanual manipulation, from 2% to 60%, without any real robot demonstration of those tasks. Moreover, training with our synthetic data matches the performance of policies trained solely on teleoperated demonstrations at approximately a third of the collection cost, demonstrating the cost efficiency of our approach.
items.abstract_zh: 机器人基础模型适配新任务仍依赖遥操作。人类视频可扩展，但叠加机器人或重定向姿态对高自由度机器人有视觉与动作鸿沟。RoboTryOn 将人机转换视为虚拟试穿：保留演示动作，把人类换成参考图像指定的目标机器人，并保持任务、物体与背景。方法自回归翻译关键帧，以人手骨架运动引导合成，再用融合深度特征的逆动力学模型推断动作标签。多类人形机器人实验显示，仅用合成数据训练的策略在新任务上平均成功率由2%升至60%，以约三分之一采集成本达到遥操作训练水平。
items.highlight_zh: 以虚拟试穿把人类视频换成机器人演示，成功率2%→60%
items.digest_zh: 研究问题：机器人基础模型控制能力虽强，但每学一个新任务往往还要人遥操作采集大量演示；用第一人称人类视频替代会面临“看起来像人、动作也是人的”视觉与动作不匹配，高自由度机器人尤其明显。方法：RoboTryOn 把“人类视频→机器人演示”类比为虚拟试穿——人物动作不动，只把“衣服”换成机器人。它先用参考图指定目标机器人，将人类视频转成该机器人在原任务、原物体、原背景下执行动作的视频；为保持一致性，自回归地翻译关键帧，并用人类手部骨架运动作为条件引导视频生成；最后用带深度特征的逆动力学模型从合成视频反推动作标签，供策略学习。结果：在多类人形机器人上，仅用合成数据训练的策略在包括双臂操作的新任务上，平均成功率从2%提升到60%，且这些任务没有任何真实机器人演示；其表现与只用遥操作演示训练的策略相当，而数据采集成本约为后者的三分之一。意义：这说明可以把海量人类视频低成本“换皮”成目标机器人可学的演示，绕过高成本遥操作，为机器人基础模型的新任务适配提供可扩展路径；同时虚拟试穿式思路把视觉生成与动作推断解耦，便于跨形态迁移。

rm.usage: 用人类视频合成机器人演示并反推动作标签，可用于为工程机器人机械臂装配（42mm 发射机构、能量单元）低成本生成示教数据训练抓取/装配策略；但与 RM 的视觉位姿识别主线只是间接相关。

items.title_en: iMED: A Multi-Endoscope Dataset for Surgical 3D Perception
items.title_zh: iMED：用于手术3D感知的多内窥镜数据集
items.abstract_en: We introduce iMED, the first synchronized multi-endoscope dataset for robot-assisted minimally invasive surgery (RAMIS), designed to address a fundamental limitation in surgical vision benchmarking: the absence of independent held-out viewpoints. Existing surgical datasets capture single-trajectory sequences from a single endoscope, making it impossible to distinguish geometric generalization from photometric interpolation along a narrow forward-facing path. iMED provides 340 sequences ~170K synchronized timepoints with 4 views per timepoint) recorded simultaneously from two independent stereo endoscopes across ex vivo, postmortem, and live surgical settings, spanning 14 specimens with diverse anatomical regions and motion regimes. The dataset includes calibrated camera intrinsics, ArUco-based frame-wise pose estimates with uncertainty quantification, instrument segmentation masks, and rich clinical metadata. Using a train-on-one-endoscope, test-on-another evaluation protocol, we benchmark 23 state-of-the-art methods across rigid and deformable novel view synthesis, pose estimation, feature matching, and monocular depth estimation. Our experiments show that methods relying primarily on photometric supervision degrade substantially under this held-out-endoscope setting, while methods with explicit geometric regularization are more robust across views in our benchmark. Notably, large-scale foundation models transfer surprisingly well to surgical imagery, often outperforming domain-specific models, suggesting pitfalls in current fine-tuning protocols. iMED establishes a new evaluation protocol for geometric generalization in surgical vision.
items.abstract_zh: 该文提出 iMED，首个面向机器人辅助微创手术的同步多内窥镜数据集，解决手术视觉基准缺乏独立留出视角的问题。现有数据多为单镜单轨迹，难区分几何泛化与光度插值。iMED 含340段序列、约17万同步时刻（每时刻4视角），由两个立体内窥镜在离体、尸检和活体场景采集，覆盖14标本；提供标定内参、带不确定度的ArUco位姿、器械掩码和临床元数据。采用一镜训练、另一镜测试协议，评测23种方法。依赖光度监督的方法显著退化，显式几何正则更稳健；大规模基础模型迁移良好，常优于领域专用模型。
items.highlight_zh: 首个多内窥镜同步手术数据集，揭示留出视角几何泛化差距
items.digest_zh: 研究问题：手术视觉里要判断一个3D感知算法是真懂几何，还是只在一条熟悉轨迹上做图像插值，需要“独立留出视角”。但现有手术数据集基本由单个内窥镜沿一条轨迹拍摄，训练和测试视角高度相关，难以检验跨视角几何泛化。方法：作者构建 iMED，用两个独立立体内窥镜在同一场景同步拍摄，形成每时刻4视角的数据；覆盖离体、尸检和活体场景，共14个标本，包含340段序列、约17万同步时刻。数据附带相机内参标定、基于ArUco的逐帧位姿及不确定度、器械分割掩码和临床元数据。评测采用“一镜训练、另一镜测试”协议，对23种先进方法在刚性/形变新视角合成、位姿估计、特征匹配和单目深度估计上做基准。结果：主要依赖光度监督的方法在留出内窥镜下明显掉点，而有显式几何正则的方法更稳健；大规模基础模型迁移到手术图像上表现意外地好，常超过领域专用模型，暴露出现有微调流程可能存在的问题。意义：iMED 提供了首个多内窥镜同步手术3D感知基准和更严格的几何泛化评测协议，提醒社区不要被同一轨迹上的高指标误导，也为手术视觉基础模型的选择与微调提供了新参照。
items.comment: Published at ECCV 2026. 25 pages, including supplementary material. Code and dataset: https://github.com/surgical-vision/imed

items.title_en: GeoDIVE: Geospatial Descent Informed by Value Estimation
items.title_zh: GeoDIVE：由价值估计引导的地理空间下降
items.abstract_en: Finding specific objects, structures, and spatial patterns supports critical work in agriculture, infrastructure planning, environmental monitoring, and disaster response. These features, however, are often dispersed across very large regions and span dramatically different spatial scales, which defines a search space that is costly to embed, maintain, and search naively. We introduce GeoDIVE, a model that treats a multiresolution satellite image gallery as a forest and uses best-first traversal to determine which tiles to encode. At each visited node, a lightweight model then predicts an optimistic estimate of the best query similarity hidden among its descendants using the query and subtree representations. In evaluations with image and open-vocabulary text queries, GeoDIVE matches exhaustive search at 10% of the encoding cost for image queries and leads all tested baselines at every budget in both modalities. To support future evaluation of multiscale geospatial search, we also release object-level image and text queries for Git-10M, constructed from Microsoft building footprints and OpenStreetMap polygons with VLM-generated captions. Source code and models will be made publicly available.
items.comment: Accepted to WACV 2027. Includes supplementary material

rm.usage: 面向超大范围卫星图库的分辨率自适应搜索与价值估计，与 RoboMaster 的场地内近距离感知差异极大，最多只能把「先粗后细、按价值决定是否精细处理」的思路借到雷达多相机巡检或大场景搜索上，落地价值很低。

items.title_en: BhopalMLS: A LiDAR Dataset for Semantic Scene Understanding in Heterogeneous Urban Environments
items.title_zh: BhopalMLS：用于异构城市环境中语义场景理解的LiDAR数据集
items.abstract_en: We introduce BhopalMLS, a large-scale Mobile Laser Scanning (MLS) dataset from a dense, heterogeneous urban environment in Bhopal, India, with mixed traffic, informal structures, and narrow unplanned streets. It spans approximately 10 km of road corridors with over 1.2 billion points and 19,518 annotated instances across 62 fine-grained static categories, grouped into 12-class and 21-class benchmark taxonomies; 6 optional moving-class subclasses support dynamic-object analysis. Existing 3D datasets, collected in well-planned cities, are structurally more uniform than such unplanned settings, and lack their subtype diversity. On semantic and instance segmentation at both granularities, fine-tuned foundation models surpass supervised baselines: Utonia(L) reaches 71.28% mIoU (vs. PTv3's 68.04% from scratch) and 44.07% mAP50 on the 12-class benchmark. Cross-region experiments against four established datasets (Ke-MLS, Toronto-3D, Paris-Lille-3D, SemanticKITTI) reveal a consistent asymmetric transferability: models trained on BhopalMLS transfer better than the reverse on every pair, for both Utonia(L) and Concerto(L) (mean 21.5, up to 36 mIoU points), holding even when the target is denser. Factor-controlled retraining at a fixed label budget, repeated on both models, attributes this to the coverage of BhopalMLS's subtype inventory rather than to dataset size or corridor geometry: collapsing each class to a single subtype costs 13.0 and 13.3 mIoU points for Utonia(L) and Concerto(L). BhopalMLS therefore offers a testbed for 3D perception beyond well-planned cities. Data and an interactive viewer are at https://geoai4cities.github.io/bhopalmls.
items.comment: Accepted at WACV 2027 (Evaluations and Datasets Track). 37 pages: main paper, references and supplementary material. Project page: https://geoai4cities.github.io/bhopalmls

items.title_en: Gradient-Guided Orientation Learning for Weakly Supervised Oriented Object Detection
items.title_zh: 梯度引导的朝向学习用于弱监督有向目标检测
items.abstract_en: Weakly supervised oriented object detection (WS-OOD) aims to reduce the annotation cost of rotated bounding boxes by leveraging cheaper annotations such as horizontal boxes or points. However, these weak annotations provide no explicit orientation information, forcing existing methods to infer object angles through indirect geometric consistency or equivariant constraints. Such indirect supervision often becomes ambiguous and unstable under real-world appearance variations, including illumination changes, color shifts, shadows, and background clutter. In this paper, we present a simple yet effective gradient-guided orientation learning strategy for WS-OOD. Motivated by the observation that the input image itself contains useful orientation priors, our method extracts dominant gradient-based orientation cues from object regions and converts them into pseudo-angle labels for auxiliary supervision, enabling the detector to learn orientation-aware representations without requiring rotated bounding box annotations or extra learnable parameters. Furthermore, since AP can mask substantial angular errors when spatial IoU remains high, we introduce an orientation-aware evaluation metric that incorporates angular discrepancies into the standard AP protocol. Extensive experiments on weakly supervised oriented detection benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed pseudo-angle supervision improves both detection performance and orientation estimation quality, while the proposed metric provides a more faithful assessment of angle prediction than conventional AP alone.
items.comment: Accepted to WACV 2027. 10 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables

items.title_en: How Finely Can Vision-Language Models See Biology? Bio-VQA: A Benchmark for Taxonomic, Morphological, Spatial and Individual Reasoning
items.title_zh: 视觉语言模型能多精细地看懂生物学？Bio-VQA：面向分类学、形态学、空间与个体推理的基准
items.abstract_en: In biodiversity monitoring, a single image raises several questions: which taxon, how many, which trait, and whether the individual has been seen before. Vision-language models (VLMs) could answer all of these from the image, but their ability is largely untested in biology, as existing benchmarks focus mostly on species identification within a few taxonomic groups. We present Bio-VQA, the largest biological visual question answering (VQA) benchmark and the only one to span four aspects of biological visual understanding: hierarchical taxonomic reasoning, fine-grained attribute grounding, quantitative spatial reasoning, and individual re-identification. Bio-VQA contains 1.86M questions over 217K images from 11 public datasets, and extends right-or-wrong scoring to graded scoring, so a near-miss counts for more than a distant one. Evaluating 18 open-weight models from 3.75B to 38.4B parameters, we find that general visual capabilities do not transfer to biological organisms: the best model counts animals exactly on 41.7% of images with 2 to 10 individuals, less than half its accuracy on everyday objects at the same counts. Taxonomic accuracy falls to one sixth, from 0.72 at phylum to 0.12 at scientific name, and scaling helps mostly at coarse ranks. The gap to a domain specialist widens accordingly, from 0.731 against BioCLIP-2's 0.874 at class (1.2x) to 0.269 against 0.544 at scientific name (2x). On trait size measurement, 15 of the 18 models do no better than an image-blind baseline that predicts one fixed number for every specimen, and on re-identification, 17 of the 18 models fall below chance under adversarial conditions. These failures persist across a tenfold range of model size. We hope Bio-VQA becomes a standard test of how well VLM capabilities transfer to the biological domain.
items.comment: Accepted to WACV 2027, 8 pages main paper; 4 figures, 4 tables

items.title_en: ReVA-HPE: Relative 6DoF Head Pose Estimation with Synthetic Pose Supervision and Personalized Virtual Anchors
items.title_zh: ReVA-HPE：基于合成位姿监督与个性化虚拟锚点的相对6DoF头部姿态估计
items.abstract_en: Monocular head pose estimation is usually formulated as absolute regression from a single face crop, yet many applications observe the same person over time and can supply an explicit anchor image. Recently, relative head pose estimation was proposed, which casts the problem as estimation of the relative geometric change between an anchor and a query image. However, existing methods still require the anchor image pose to be known at inference, significantly limiting their practical use. We first extend relative head pose estimation to full 6DoF by additionally predicting a depth-normalized relative translation, which composes with the anchor to recover metric query pose in the camera frame. To eliminate the need for a ground-truth anchor pose, we reconstruct a personalized avatar from a single unlabeled enrollment image and render a bank of virtual anchors with known poses. The bank provides robust rotation hypotheses through multi-anchor consensus, while the real enrollment image serves as the real anchor in the translation branch via landmark PnP. We also introduce an efficient variant that amortizes the bank cost once at enrollment, after which each query requires a single real-to-real relative prediction, with limited accuracy sacrifice. The relative pose estimator is trained exclusively on synthetic face renderings, without real pose supervision, pseudo-labels, domain adaptation, or fine-tuning on the evaluation sets. On real 6DoF benchmarks, ReVA-HPE achieves state-of-the-art rotation accuracy on BIWI and, given a near-frontal enrollment image, on FaMoS, while remaining competitive in metric translation despite relying solely on synthetic pose supervision. Project page and code: https://vasilikivas.github.io/ReVA-HPE/

items.title_en: VerifLM: Physically Verified Image-Edit-Guided Goal Pose Generation for Robotic Manipulation
items.title_zh: VerifLM：面向机器人操作的物理验证图像编辑引导目标位姿生成
items.abstract_en: Many manipulation goals are easier to visualize than to specify numerically through explicit geometric constraints. We present VerifLM, a framework that converts image-edited goal configurations into physically verified 6-DoF object poses for planning. Using an edited image, VerifLM recovers an initial relative pose between an active object and a passive object, then prompts a vision-language model to generate axis-wise sampling constraints and a task-specific validation program. Candidate poses are evaluated in a physics simulator, and the VLM selects the most task-consistent retained candidate. To operate without predefined object meshes or physical parameters, VerifLM reconstructs metric object geometry from RGB-D observations and constructs multiple hypothetical simulations with varying physics and geometry. Parallel-world validation evaluates candidates across geometry--physics variations and ranks them by the number of worlds in which they satisfy the validation program. We evaluate VerifLM on nine manipulation tasks. VerifLM achieves the highest task success on eight of nine tasks, with the largest performance gain on goals requiring precise orientation and contact relationships.

rm.usage: 可把工程机器人装配目标（如能量单元、42mm发射机构）用图像编辑表达，再转成经物理验证的6DoF目标位姿供机械臂规划；思路可用于 engineer 的视觉装配目标位姿生成，但需替换为RM对象与仿真验证。

items.title_en: Latent Spectral Prompting for Multimodal Hyperspectral Object Tracking
items.title_zh: 面向多模态高光谱目标跟踪的潜在谱提示
items.abstract_en: Hyperspectral videos provide rich spectral signatures for robust tracking under challenging conditions such as camouflage and low illumination. However, limited hyperspectral annotations and the large RGB-hyperspectral domain gap hinder the direct use of modern temporally pretrained RGB trackers. We propose SProTrack, a multimodal framework that transfers temporal knowledge from pretrained RGB trackers to the hyperspectral domain through latent spectral prompting. The key idea is to decouple temporal modeling from spectral adaptation, allowing temporal dynamics to be inherited from RGB foundation models while hyperspectral information is learned from unlabeled data in a self-supervised manner. Unlike band-selection methods that discard most spectral information or prompt-based approaches that rely on local-search crops, SProTrack learns a global, scene-level spectral representation from the full hyperspectral frame using an autoencoder. This latent representation is used to guide spectral prompt extraction while a pretrained RGB tracker preserves strong temporal modeling on RGB-compatible inputs. By encoding spectral-spatial structure into compact latent prompts, SProTrack bridges the RGB-hyperspectral modality gap without extensive retraining or dense supervision. Experiments on HOT2020 and HOT2023 demonstrate that SProTrack achieves the best overall performance, with strong results across all spectral domains.
items.comment: Accepted at the IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV 2027)

items.title_en: TERA: Task-Evidence Restoration for Underwater Object Detection under Bandwidth-Constrained Transmission
items.title_zh: TERA：带宽受限传输下基于任务证据恢复的水下目标检测
items.abstract_en: Underwater object detectors are typically evaluated on pre-transmission images, overlooking additional degradation from bandwidth-constrained downscaling and compression. We introduce AquaTX, a controlled benchmark built from real underwater detection datasets with seen and held-out codecs. We also propose TERA, a metadata-blind receiver-side framework combining task-guided pixel restoration and dual-state feature correction while keeping the detector frozen. Under seen compound degradation, TERA improves mean average precision (mAP50:95, averaged over IoU thresholds from 0.50 to 0.95) from 37.7 to 50.0 on DUO-TX and from 31.5 to 41.3 on RUOD-TX relative to the frozen detector without restoration. TERA also preserves clean-input performance and remains competitive with detector fine-tuning under the held-out AVIF codec. These findings support transmission-aware evaluation and task-guided restoration for underwater object detection. Code is available at https://github.com/hijinkim/TERA.

items.title_en: Reward Budgeting Reduces Premature Convergence in Reinforcement Learning for LLM Reasoning
items.title_zh: 奖励预算分配减少LLM推理强化学习中的过早收敛
items.abstract_en: RL for LLM reasoning often reaches an early performance plateau as the policy distribution becomes increasingly sharp. Recent work has studied policy entropy as both a diagnostic and a control signal for this behavior. In our experiments, however, increasing entropy alone does not reliably change the eventual plateau. We analyze RL through its implicit target policy and derive a sharpness factor $κ$, together with an effective counterpart $κ_{\mathrm{eff}}$, that describes how strongly reward or advantage gaps are translated into probability-ratio gaps. Motivated by this view, we introduce \emph{reward budgeting}, a plug-in advantage construction that assigns a fixed total reward budget to each prompt. For binary rewards and independent on-policy rollouts, its unclipped score-function estimator follows the gradient of an exact finite-$G$ concave objective with diminishing returns, while its advantage gap decreases as more rollouts become correct. For general rewards, a shifted log-mean interpretation holds asymptotically under the stated regularity conditions. These results motivate, rather than establish exact objective equivalence for, the clipped implementations. On Qwen3-8B and Llama3.2-3B-Instruct, reward budgeting consistently improves a range of RL baselines, with gains up to +12.50 on AMC23 and +10.00 on AIME24 and AIME25. Overall, our results support an update-dynamics view of premature convergence and show that strong gains can be obtained without explicitly preserving entropy.

rm.usage: 讨论 LLM 推理 RL 中奖励差距到概率比的锐度控制与奖励预算分配，可借鉴到仿真环境中训练自瞄/决策策略时抑制过早收敛（如熵/优势缩放调度），但需针对连续控制改造，属思路参考。

items.title_en: ProAlign: Progressive Positional and Prototype-Guided Alignment for Aerial-Ground Person Re-Identification
items.title_zh: ProAlign：面向空-地行人重识别的渐进式位置与原型引导对齐
items.abstract_en: Aerial-Ground Person Re-Identification (AG-ReID) aims to match pedestrian images captured by unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) and ground-based surveillance cameras. The task remains highly challenging due to severe viewpoint discrepancies, frequent occlusions, and substantial domain gaps between aerial and ground imagery. Beyond these observable factors, existing methods often overlook two fundamental structural issues: cumulative positional drift during hierarchical feature extraction and semantic inconsistency across cross-view feature distributions. To address these challenges, we propose ProAlign, a Progressive Positional and Prototype-Guided Alignment Network for AG-ReID. ProAlign comprises two key components: a Layer-wise Progressive Positional Embedding (LPPE) module and a View-Aware Prototype Contrastive Learning (PCL) module. LPPE performs adaptive positional calibration throughout transformer layers by employing conditional positional encoding in shallow layers to mitigate local spatial distortions, while introducing learnable static positional embeddings in deeper layers to reinforce global semantic priors. Meanwhile, PCL maintains view-specific aerial and ground prototypes for each identity and enforces cross-view semantic consistency via a dual-prototype contrastive objective. Extensive experiments on CARGO and two real-world AG-ReID benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of ProAlign, achieving state-of-the-art overall retrieval performance on CARGO with improvements of 1.60% in Rank-1 accuracy and 5.01% in mAP over the strongest competing methods.

items.title_en: LLMs as MDP Designers: A Dependency-Aware Agentic Framework for Automated Robot Policy Generation
items.title_zh: LLMs作为MDP设计者：面向自动化机器人策略生成的依赖感知智能体框架
items.abstract_en: We investigate the automated generation of executable robot reinforcement learning (RL) policies from natural-language task descriptions. Rather than using large language models (LLMs) as execution-time decision makers, we use them as designers that construct RL pipelines before deployment, including Markov decision process (MDP) formulation and simulator implementation. We identify a phase-wise structure in this problem: MDP formulation is dependency-structured and sequential, whereas simulator implementation becomes modular once the formulation is fixed. Based on this structure, we propose ARPG, a dependency-aware agentic framework that performs sequential MDP modeling, localized verification and correction, and simulator-structured implementation while externalizing intermediate artifacts. ARPG targets a key failure mode of automated policy generation: executable code may still yield non-learnable policies when state, action, reward, and termination artifacts are not semantically aligned. Experiments in Isaac Sim show that ARPG improves modeling correctness, environment executability, and policy-generation success compared with monolithic LLM baselines and off-the-shelf agentic systems. Additional demonstrations on custom robotics, standard RL, and engineering-domain MDPs further suggest that the same modeling pipeline can be reused beyond the main benchmark suite.
items.comment: Accepted to the 40th Annual Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)

rm.usage: 用LLM自动设计MDP并生成仿真器实现，可用于快速搭建自瞄、导航、多机决策的RL训练环境与状态/奖励设计；作为仿真与强化学习流程的辅助工具较合适，需人工校验。

items.title_en: Say the Same, Act Differently: Diagnosing and Steering Text-Action Divergence in Reasoning VLAs
items.title_zh: 言同而行异：推理型VLA中文本-动作偏离的诊断与引导
items.abstract_en: Reasoning vision-language-action (VLA) models pair physical control with natural-language rationales that supervisors can read to monitor embodied safety. Prior attacks on VLA reasoning corrupt the rationale itself and leave visible evidence in the text. We show that visual perturbations can instead alter the physical action while keeping the generated rationale word-for-word identical. At the shared text/action interface of Alpamayo for driving and InstructVLA for manipulation, our text-neutral action-subspace (TNAS) diagnostic shows that the locally most action-sensitive direction is nearly orthogonal to the active text-loss gradients, with 1.87% and 5.28% norm overlap. At equal hidden-state perturbation norms across both models, interventions along this text-neutral residual shift actions 4.64x to 47.8x more than text-gradient perturbations, whereas text-gradient perturbations induce 21.2x to 277x more text drift. Steering visual perturbations along this direction reaches the same decoupling from the image. Across 154 obstacle-annotated driving scenes in Alpamayo, TNAS-guided attacks induce a new collision under a word-for-word identical rationale in 52.6% of scenes under full-image perturbations and 35.1% under a localized forward-camera patch, compared with 4.55% for unguided action attacks. Relative to a text-preserving baseline, TNAS guidance raises exact rationale preservation from 83.0% to 89.5% and cuts teacher-forced text drift by 68.4% at a comparable collision rate. In InstructVLA, TNAS guidance cuts text drift by 40.5% and preserves the exact response on 85.0% of examples alongside a 1.73-unit action-chunk shift. An unchanged rationale therefore cannot certify a safe action, so monitors for reasoning VLAs must verify the predicted action channel directly.
items.comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. 23 pages, 3 figures, 8 tables

rm.usage: 诊断推理型VLA文本与动作偏离，RM当前算法栈基本不用VLA，和自瞄、导航、决策无直接关系；仅对将来可解释决策安全有很远参考。

items.title_en: RadPose: ISAC-based RF 3D Human Pose Estimation
items.title_zh: RadPose：基于ISAC的射频3D人体姿态估计
items.abstract_en: Human pose estimation under adverse lighting and occlusion conditions remains challenging for camera- and LiDAR-based systems. Although mmWave radars provide robustness to illumination and occlusion, they rely on dedicated hardware and licensed spectrum, limiting scalability. In this paper, we present RadPose, a learning-based monostatic integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) framework that enables mmWave communication devices to perform 3D human pose estimation. Unlike specialized radars, RadPose leverages monostatic full-duplex operation to extract channel impulse responses (CIRs) directly from standard OFDM communication signals, generating 3D radio point clouds without additional sensing hardware. To address the sparsity and noise of RF observations, RadPose employs a cross-frame transformer-based pose inference network with semantic-guided spatial attention and target-driven temporal attention for robust spatio-temporal aggregation. It further adopts a joint-aware inverse kinematics refinement module based on graph convolution to enforce skeletal topology, bone-length consistency, and anatomical plausibility. Extensive experiments demonstrate RadPose achieves competitive accuracy compared to state-of-the-art radar-based approaches while maintaining robust performance in unseen and occluded scenarios. The dataset and source code are available at https://github.com/Geo-Chou/RadPose.

rm.usage: 利用毫米波通信设备做人体3D姿态估计，RM雷达关注机器人位置/状态而非人体姿态，硬件与目标均不匹配；关联很弱。

items.title_en: An Axiomatic Framework for Reinforcement Learning in Open Multi-Agent Systems
items.title_zh: 开放多智能体系统中强化学习的公理化框架
items.abstract_en: Open multi-agent systems, where only a subset of agents are controllable, are central to real-world domains such as smart grids, yet lack a principled foundation for reinforcement learning algorithm design. We study this setting through n-agent ad hoc teamwork (NAHT), a recent framework for learning in open multi-agent environments. We propose an axiomatic framework that derives value function learning from the Shapley axioms (Efficiency, Symmetry and Linearity), treating them as structural constraints rather than heuristic design choices. This formulation builds on a novel NAHT decomposition, which characterises the fundamental difference between open and fully controllable multi-agent systems, and establishes a cooperative game-theoretic foundation for learning. We further show that enforcing these axioms on learning individual value functions recovers the Shapley value for Dec-POMDPs, providing a principled bridge between reinforcement learning and classical cooperative game theory. Building on this framework, we introduce Shapley Machines and Banzhaf Machines, two generic algorithmic templates that can be instantiated with standard reinforcement learning methods. When applied to strong base algorithms such as IPPO and POAM, our methods consistently improve learning efficiency and generalisation to unseen agent types and conventions across NAHT benchmark tasks. The code of experiments is published on https://github.com/hsvgbkhgbv/axiomatic-rl-naht.

rm.usage: 把开放多智能体+ad hoc teamwork 的框架用于哨兵/多机协同决策：队友策略未知、只有部分机器人可控（如只能收雷达数据），可用 Shapley 值分解设计各机器人贡献评估与协同奖励，用于仿真中的强化学习训练。偏理论，需自己搭环境落地。

items.title_en: ForceLDM: A Force-aware Latent Dynamics Model for Contact-Rich Manipulation
items.title_zh: ForceLDM：面向富接触操作的力感知潜在动力学模型
items.abstract_en: Contact-rich manipulation requires fine-grained control and complex physical interactions with the environment, posing significant challenges for robot policy learning. Vision-only policies struggle with such tasks, as contact states and interaction forces are difficult to infer from visual observations alone. Existing methods mitigate this issue by incorporating force or tactile sensing. However, they often treat these signals as auxiliary observations without fully exploiting their role in modeling future interaction dynamics. To address this, we propose ForceLDM, a force-aware latent dynamics model that learns future contact and motion dynamics to guide action generation. Rather than directly predicting future observations, which can entangle task-relevant dynamics with irrelevant sensory details, ForceLDM learns a compact representation of future dynamics through knowledge distillation. Specifically, a teacher network with privileged future force/torque and optical flow signals extracts future dynamic features, which are then distilled into a student network trained only on current observations. This enables the student model to reason about upcoming contacts and physical dynamics without relying on future sensory inputs at deployment. To improve robustness and generalization, we further introduce a curriculum-based progressive noise injection strategy to mitigate over-reliance on future features. Experiments on five real-world contact-rich manipulation tasks demonstrate that ForceLDM outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, generalizes effectively to novel objects, and remains robust to environmental perturbations. Project page and code are available at https://tpy001.github.io/ForceLDM/.

rm.usage: 工程机器人装配能量单元/42mm 发射机构属于富接触操作，可借鉴其力感知隐动力学建模，在机械臂末端加力/触觉反馈来判别是否到位、卡滞，提升装配成功率；但需额外的力传感器与真机数据，改造量较大。

items.title_en: The Cost of Mismatch: Noise Amplification in Zeroth-Order Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: 失配的代价：零阶强化学习中的噪声放大
items.abstract_en: Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization has emerged as a promising approach for memory-efficient large language model (LLM) post-training, yet its reliability in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) remains largely unexplored. Motivated by the distinct data regimes of on-policy RL and fixed-data optimization, we develop a generic variance-theoretic framework to investigate what limits the reliability of ZO gradient estimation. Our analysis reveals that estimation reliability is structurally determined by whether the two finite-difference evaluations are performed on matched data. On-policy reinforcement learning (RL) under the mismatched-data regime produces a $1/μ^2$ oracle-noise amplification that sets an irreducible noise floor as the perturbation scale $μ$ decreases, whereas Boltzmann Targeted SFT (BOLT) under the matched-data regime eliminates this amplification via noise cancellation. We further derive convergence guarantees with explicit constants that cleanly separate the two regimes. These results motivate the ZO-BOLT algorithm, which builds on BOLT's matched-data advantage for reliable ZO optimization of an RLVR-aligned objective. Controlled perturbation-scale sweeps and matched-versus-mismatched end-to-end comparisons validate the predicted effect of data matching. Experiments across three models and two mathematical reasoning benchmarks further show that ZO-BOLT consistently improves over the pretrained baseline while retaining a near-inference memory footprint. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/lianmin-chen/the_cost_of_mismatch.
items.comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 (Poster). Code is available at https://github.com/lianmin-chen/the_cost_of_mismatch

rm.usage: 讨论零阶优化在 RLVR 中的噪声放大，属大模型后训练理论，与自瞄、导航、决策等机器人算法关联很弱，最多作为用 ZO 估计算法调参时的方差参考。

items.title_en: MIRA: Reinforcing Multimodal Reasoning via Deceptive Contextual Augmentation
items.title_zh: MIRA：通过欺骗性上下文增强强化多模态推理
items.abstract_en: While Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has significantly advanced multimodal reasoning, existing frameworks suffer from a critical "perception-reasoning gap." Due to an over-reliance on seemingly relevant visual tokens, even minor perceptual perturbations can propagate through the reasoning process, leading to compounding hallucinations. To address this issue, we propose MIRA, a training framework that improves robustness to erroneous visual contexts while enhancing logical reasoning ability. By injecting filtered, deceptive visual contexts during training, we construct challenging "hard traps" that stress-test the model's robustness to misleading information. Furthermore, we introduce a group-wise reflection-triggering mechanism that enables the model to autonomously detect and rectify inconsistencies between visual cues and logical constraints, which is ultimately internalized as an intrinsic policy behavior. Importantly, MIRA does not rely on human annotations. Experimental results across multiple reasoning and perception benchmarks show that MIRA yields an average 7% improvement on in-domain benchmarks, with consistent improvements on vision-centric benchmarks. These findings highlight that active error recovery is essential for robust multimodal reasoning. Comprehensive ablation studies and analyses further provide insights into why MIRA is effective.

rm.usage: 面向多模态大模型推理鲁棒性的训练框架，与 RM 的视觉检测/控制链路关系很弱；若队伍用 VLM 做战术理解，可参考其对抗视觉扰动的思路，但落地成本高。

items.title_en: Iterative Gumbel Planning for Continuous Control
items.title_zh: 用于连续控制的迭代 Gumbel 规划
items.abstract_en: Search-based planning remains a powerful policy improvement paradigm in reinforcement learning, driving milestone successes in discrete domains. However, extending this paradigm to continuous control exposes a structural mismatch: search evaluates a finite set of action candidates, whereas continuous RL typically relies on Gaussian policies. We show that winner-action distillation into a continuous Gaussian induces a \textit{projection error} and a stepwise variance-expanding gradient tendency when the selected action is sufficiently far from the current mean. Empirically, this tendency is associated with elevated terminal variance and a return gap on the evaluated tasks. To address this, we propose \textbf{Iterative Gumbel Planning (IGP)}. By adopting a per-dimension factorized categorical policy, IGP naturally aligns the policy support with the search candidates, eliminating the projection error and reducing the residual approximation to a bounded discretization error. To bypass the combinatorial explosion of high-dimensional discrete action spaces, IGP pairs Gumbel Top-$K$ candidate sampling with an MPPI-style multi-round iterative search to refine the policy at each state. Empirically, IGP achieves state-of-the-art aggregate performance and sample efficiency on DMControl and HumanoidBench. Furthermore, it produces more stable action sequences with lower temporal variance, demonstrating its practical potential for real-world robotic deployment.

rm.usage: 把基于搜索的策略改进（Gumbel 规划）用到连续控制任务，例如哨兵局部路径规划、云台跟踪或仿真中的强化学习策略提升，可缓解高斯策略与搜索动作间的投影误差；需在自建仿真中改造实现。

items.title_en: PolicyIK: High-Precision Inverse Kinematics for Robot Arms with Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: PolicyIK：基于强化学习的高精度机械臂逆运动学
items.abstract_en: Inverse kinematics (IK) converts end-effector pose commands into joint motion, and many vision-language-action (VLA) policies rely on it to act on a given arm and to transfer across embodiments. Precise IK remains laborious: redundancy and singularities complicate the inverse mapping, execution depends on hand-tuned controllers, and training data on physical robots are costly to collect. We present PolicyIK, a goal-conditioned reinforcement learning policy for high-precision IK. It updates joint-position references from pose feedback and observes its accumulated reference relative to the measured joints, so it can retain the offset that the position controller needs at rest. Two-scale pose errors with an error-dependent action gain resolve millimeter residuals while preserving large motions. Progress and dwell rewards teach it to both reach the tolerance and stay within it. In simulation, a single attempt by the trained PPO policy keeps the mean errors over the final second within 1 mm and 0.2° on 93.5% of held-out tasks, and a deployment protocol raises success to 98.9%. When trained directly on a physical arm with an off-policy RL learner, PolicyIK achieves higher reaching and holding success than all four classical IK controllers under the same time budgets. In simulated pick-and-place, PolicyIK executes the end-effector commands of the $π_{0.5}$ VLA policy with 95.7% success. These results show that reinforcement learning can provide high-precision inverse kinematics for robot arms. Code is available at https://github.com/Tinaliu0123/PolicyIK.

rm.usage: 可直接用于工程机器人机械臂的高精度逆运动学：以位姿反馈驱动关节参考更新，替代手调 IK 控制器，便于视觉标签/科技核心位姿到关节指令的映射与跨构型迁移；需在仿真或真机上训练对齐。

items.title_en: GUILD: Guided Iterative Data Collection for Imitation Learning
items.title_zh: GUILD：面向模仿学习的引导式迭代数据收集
items.abstract_en: Imitation learning policies in robotics are trained on datasets collected through costly real-world teleoperation. Often, the data-collection process is unguided, relying on the teleoperator's intuition, resulting in data that contributes little to overall policy performance. Recent work has shown that curating such unguided datasets can substantially improve policy performance, but these approaches operate by filtering existing datasets after collection and therefore do not prevent the acquisition of uninformative data. In this work, we propose GUILD, a novel Guided Data Collection (GDC) method that actively reasons about which data should be collected to maximize downstream policy performance. We introduce an iterative framework that alternates between 1) task proposal and data collection and 2) data evaluation to close the loop. For task proposal, we leverage semantic priors from vision-language models to identify relevant environments, object configurations, and goals for data collection. However, since semantic relevance does not imply policy improvement, we perform data evaluation. By leveraging predictive data attribution we approximate how the collected trajectories influence policy performance on a target deployment setting. This signal is then used as feedback to guide subsequent data collection, closing the data collection loop. We evaluate our approach in simulation and real robot settings, demonstrating that guided data collection substantially improves sample efficiency and deployment performance compared to passive data collection strategies, multiple baselines and experienced roboticists. More information at https://robin-lab.cs.utexas.edu/guild2026/

rm.usage: 若用模仿学习训练工程装配或操作策略，可借鉴其引导式数据收集降低遥操作采集成本；不过 RM 工程装配多走传统视觉伺服+解析控制，实用价值有限。

items.title_en: EgoMo3R: Joint Egocentric Motion and Scene Reconstruction
items.title_zh: EgoMo3R：联合自我中心运动与场景重建
items.abstract_en: Understanding holistic 3D human motion and the surrounding environment from egocentric video is fundamental for applications in AR/VR and robotics. Although these tasks are inherently coupled, existing methods treat them separately. In particular, egocentric motion reconstruction methods typically assume access to metric, gravity-aligned camera trajectories from specialized inertial sensors. Recovering such trajectories from monocular egocentric video remains a significant challenge due to rapid head movements and motion blur. We present EgoMo3R, a joint optimization framework that simultaneously reconstructs 3D human motion and scene geometry from casual egocentric video. It leverages the robustness of low-level visuo-geometric primitives, including monocular depth, optical flow, and point tracks, integrated with a diffusion-based human motion prior via first-order optimization. We propose an alternating optimization scheme that establishes a synergistic feedback loop: scene reconstruction provides physical grounding and trajectory conditioning for the motion prior, while the motion prior regularizes the camera trajectory and anchors the scene in a metric, gravity-aligned world frame. We evaluate EgoMo3R on the highly dynamic sequences of the EgoExo4D and Nymeria datasets and show that it outperforms specialized baselines in both 3D scene reconstruction and egocentric motion estimation.

rm.usage: 自我中心人体运动与场景联合重建，主要面向 AR/VR 与人体动作捕捉，与车载云台自瞄、场地建图导航等需求不匹配，基本用不上。

items.title_en: LumiTac: Compact, High-Rate Six-Axis Optical Tactile Sensing for Human-Robot Interaction
items.title_zh: LumiTac：面向人机交互的紧凑型高速率六轴光学触觉传感
items.abstract_en: Integrating six-axis tactile feedback into robotic interfaces requires compact sensors with accurate load measurement and rapid online reconstruction. This paper presents LumiTac, a low-profile, camera-free optoelectronic tactile sensor combining spatially distributed illumination with spectral encoding. Five photoemitters and five RGBW photoreceivers are mounted on opposing circuit boards coupled through translucent silicone. Load-induced interlayer motion modulates the internal light field under compression, shear, bending, and torsion. The sensing head measures 12 mm in diameter and 4.75 mm in thickness, weighs less than 2 g, and has a component cost of approximately USD 7. A compact multilayer perceptron reconstructs three force and three moment components from 20 optical channels. Independent testing yielded coefficients of determination (R-squared) of 0.9657-0.9941, with mean absolute errors of 0.054-0.190 N for forces and 0.304-1.419 mN m for moments. Online prediction achieved an average update rate of 303.57 Hz and a median software processing latency of 0.722 ms. Experiments involving combined loading, light weights, and rapid tapping evaluated load tracking, sensitivity to small forces, and transient response, respectively. Robotic demonstrations further validated its applicability to tactile-guided manipulation and physical human-robot interaction. This study paves the way for compact, high-rate optical tactile sensing in robotic manipulation and human-robot interaction.

rm.usage: 紧凑六轴光学触觉传感器，可为工程机器人机械臂抓取与装配（42mm 发射机构、能量单元插装）提供腕部力/力矩反馈，辅助插装对准与防过载，但需自行集成硬件与力控策略。

items.title_en: GSBR: Geometric Support Behavior Regularization for Online RL
items.title_zh: GSBR：在线强化学习的几何支持行为正则化
items.abstract_en: Regularizing online reinforcement learning (RL) toward a pretrained base policy can improve sample efficiency and learning stability, but regularization that is too restrictive limits how much the policy can improve. Base policies -- typically diffusion or flow-matching models trained by imitation learning on large, diverse datasets -- capture many behaviors that are reasonable but suboptimal. Existing regularizers using such base policies are too restrictive in one of two ways: behavioral cloning regularizers pull the actor toward the full base-policy distribution, penalizing it for discarding suboptimal modes, while hard support constraints forbid improvements that lie just outside the base policy's support. We propose Geometric Support Behavior Regularization (GSBR), which penalizes actions by their distance from the base policy's support. Actions within the support incur no penalty, so the actor can concentrate on high-value modes; outside the support, where value estimates are less reliable, the penalty grows smoothly with distance while still permitting improvement when the value gained outweighs the penalty. GSBR estimates this distance from a finite set of base-policy samples, so it requires only sample access to the base policy. Across 19 tasks on four robotic benchmarks, GSBR raises the average success rate from 33% for the base policy to 95%, achieving the highest average success rate and throughput among all compared methods, with about 23% higher normalized throughput than the next-best RL method. Project website and open-source code at https://charlesxu0124.github.io/gsbr/ .

rm.usage: 可用于仿真环境中训练自瞄、导航或决策策略时，作为在线强化学习的正则化方法，在保留预训练策略先验的同时避免限制策略改进。

items.title_en: Diversity-Aware Experience Replay via Statistical Leverage Scores
items.title_zh: 基于统计杠杆分数的多样性感知经验回放
items.abstract_en: Off-policy deep reinforcement learning trains on random samples from a replay buffer of past experience. In physical robot settings, that buffer is dominated by routine: thousands of near-identical transitions from normal operation, while the rare events that define the edges of the task are rarely sampled. We propose scoring every stored transition by its statistical leverage, which measures how unusual it is relative to the buffer's own data, computed from the stored numbers alone, with no labels, rewards, or value network. We draw each mini-batch from a mixture of this score and uniform sampling. First, the natural way to build the score along the directions where the data varies most turns out to be blind when actions are stored as one-hot indicators, because indicator columns always win the variance ranking; we instead select the feature columns with the heaviest tails (largest kurtosis) where small far-away populations are revealed. Second, the importance weights that prioritized replay uses to keep gradients unbiased cancel the method exactly: with full correction, training matches uniform sampling, so we drop the correction and deliberately optimize the rebalanced objective. Third, when the rare situations of a log are relational, visible only in how a stretch of behavior relates to its goal, not in any single stored coordinate-per-transition scores are blind; applying the same tail rule to short trajectory windows described relative to their goal restores the signal, and on a three-joint arm that must push an object around an obstacle it raises the rare-task success from 0.49 to 0.69 against a labeled-oracle ceiling of 0.74.

rm.usage: 用统计杠杆分数衡量样本稀有度并做优先回放，可让仿真中训练哨兵导航/战术决策/自瞄的 RL 更频繁采样碰撞、被击、极限对枪等稀有转折样本，提升训练效率，属训练工具层面的改造。

items.title_en: Stabilizing On-Policy Targeted Guidance in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: 稳定智能体强化学习中的同策略目标引导
items.abstract_en: Naive on-policy RL is often bottlenecked by the capabilities of the base model --- insufficient coverage can result in an inability to learn from certain rewards. At the same time, rewards in modern post-training systems often come from rich textual sources, e.g. judge models with a rubric of criteria. Can we utilize such structures to provide a rich directional signal that enables improving on otherwise difficult to optimize rewards? In this work, we examine a framework we refer to as targeted guidance that learns from per-turn textual feedback via an on-policy self-distillation objective. Our focus is not only on directly improving hard-to-optimize behaviors, but on how to do so throughout the training process without degrading baseline RL performance. Over a range of settings across an agentic multi-turn software engineering environment, we find success by combining targeted self-distillation with a per-criteria RL reward, and by limiting feedback to turns where the policy specifically fails. We further examine the design choices that lead to stable entropy and reduce oscillatory behavior throughout training.

rm.usage: 该方法关注利用文本反馈进行同策略强化学习，与RoboMaster以数值奖励和规则机制为主的训练流程关联较弱，仅可作RL训练思路参考。

items.title_en: Should the Action Expert Train the VLM? Action-Token Supervision and Gradient Routing in Mixture-of-Transformer VLAs
items.title_zh: 动作专家是否应训练 VLM？混合 Transformer VLA 中的动作 Token 监督与梯度路由
items.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models increasingly pair a pre-trained vision-language model (VLM) with a flow-matching expert that conditions its action predictions on the VLM's key-value representations. Those representations must carry information useful for control, yet the VLM was never trained for the action expert's flow-matching objective. Two signals can address this: gradients backpropagated from the expert's loss (coupling), or VLM supervision to predict discrete tokens encoding the same target actions. Prominent training recipes forgo the first, blocking expert-to-VLM gradients (insulation) to protect the VLM's existing capabilities, while also supervising it on vision-language data and action tokens. Because vision-language co-training also aims to preserve those capabilities, the additional protection provided by insulation is unclear. At the same time, insulation removes a direct signal about which features continuous action prediction requires. On the other hand, action-token supervision offers an alternative way to learn action-relevant representations, which may explain why insulation succeeds in practice. We disentangle these factors in autonomous driving and manipulation by independently varying action-token supervision and whether the expert's loss updates the VLM. In open-loop driving, insulation is competitive with coupling when action tokens are supervised; without them, coupling reduces trajectory-prediction error by roughly 25%. When both components are trained jointly from the outset, coupling increases closed-loop driving route progress by approximately 17% with action-token supervision and 40% without it, and similarly improves robot manipulation performance under both settings. These findings show that the value of gradient insulation depends on the VLM's action supervision and the evaluation setting, challenging insulation as a default VLA training recipe.

rm.usage: 论文讨论VLA中动作专家与VLM的联合训练，和工程机器人视觉装配的机械臂操作有间接参考，但RoboMaster当前装配任务更依赖几何位姿识别，直接用处有限。

items.title_en: FWIK: Multi-Waypoint IK Selection via Lookahead Graph Search
items.title_zh: FWIK：通过前瞻图搜索的多路点IK选择
items.abstract_en: An ordered sequence of end-effector poses can give a redundant robot arm multiple valid joint configurations at each waypoint. Inverse kinematics (IK) computes these configurations. Choosing a configuration only for the next waypoint can leave the arm poorly placed for later waypoints. This may increase planned motion time or cause a later planning failure. This paper presents Future-Window Inverse Kinematics (FWIK), an online method that selects IK solutions by considering a small window of future waypoints. FWIK generates several IK candidates, connects them in a layered joint-space graph, and ranks candidate paths with a simple motion-time estimate. A learned model removes paths whose transitions are likely to cause self-collision. A standard MoveIt 2 planner then checks the next-waypoint IK goals from the remaining paths in ranked order, and the first goal that yields a valid trajectory is selected for execution. We evaluate FWIK in simulation on two 7-DoF manipulators, the Franka Emika Panda and the KUKA LBR iiwa. Each method-planner setting contains five repetitions of 100 sequences with 50 waypoints. Across Pilz, RRT-Connect, CHOMP, and STOMP, FWIK completes 96.8-100% of sequences and gives the shortest planned trajectory duration in all eight robot-planner settings. Its mean duration is 12.8-13.1% lower than STAMPEDE, 22.5-25.6% lower than IKLink, and 27.5-37.2% lower than retry-based TRAC-IK. The results show that a small future window can improve sequence completion and reduce planned motion time while leaving final trajectory validation to the motion planner.

items.title_en: Reality and Perceptual Gaps in Expressive Swarm Robotics
items.title_zh: 表现性集群机器人中的现实与感知差距
items.abstract_en: Moving robot swarms from simulation into the physical world can be difficult because small discrepancies in hardware, timing and communication can cascade across interacting robots and alter group behaviour. This challenge is known as the reality gap. When swarms operate in human environments, a second challenge emerges: a perceptual gap between what the swarm physically does and what human onlookers actually perceive. This study examines the same decentralised coordination code deployed across three robotic swarms-tabletop, aerial and human-scale mobile manipulators-during live artistic performances. We find that while the underlying algorithms executed reliably on all three platforms, physical embodiment drastically altered visible motion-distorting execution timescales by more than a factor of three and reshaping trajectory geometry. More importantly, audience surveys revealed that human interpretation does not mirror technical success: how observers attribute meaning (perceived purpose) and how they react emotionally (comfort versus threat) depend heavily on physical form. Meaning attribution and emotional responses did not vary together. Our results demonstrate that successfully transferring swarm software to physical hardware is insufficient for real-world deployment. Addressing the reality gap does not guarantee that the resulting collective motion will be readily interpreted by human observers. Swarms destined for human environments must be engineered not only for decentralised stability but also for the expressive physical dynamics through which humans interpret collective motion.

items.title_en: Feature Puzzles: Single-Image Supervision for Multi-View 3D-Aware Segmentation
items.title_zh: Feature Puzzles：多视图三维感知分割的单图像监督
items.abstract_en: Humans can easily recognize the same objects across different viewpoints of a 3D scene, whereas teaching models such multi-view-consistent perception typically requires videos or calibrated multi-view captures, which are considerably more expensive and less diverse than large-scale monocular data.~In this paper, we introduce Feature Puzzles, a novel framework for learning multi-view-consistent segmentation using only single-image semantic segmentation supervision. Specifically, we propose a simple yet effective pipeline that constructs multi-view-consistent segmentation pseudo-labels through image cropping and geometric transformations. We further introduce a lightweight, plug-and-play network that leverages the multi-view-consistent image features learned by existing pretrained 3D foundation models and the generated pseudo-labels to perform multi-view-consistent segmentation. Importantly, our flexible framework supports various types of prompts provided from one or multiple views and can be readily extended to open-vocabulary 3D segmentation. Under this single-image supervision, our feed-forward model achieves the best mIoU on NVOS, remains competitive on SPIn-NeRF and ScanNet++ against baselines using per-scene optimization or in-domain multi-view training, and demonstrates zero-shot transfer to open-vocabulary 3D segmentation. Visual comparisons are available on our project page: https://featurepuzzles.github.io/

items.title_en: Asynchronous Robot Policies
items.title_zh: 异步机器人策略
items.abstract_en: Scaling vision-language foundation models has significantly advanced generalist robot manipulation, but the increased model scale introduces computational latency that degrades real-time physical reactivity. Existing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) architectures execute high-level semantic reasoning and action ex- ecution sequentially within the primary control loop, creating a fundamental tension between semantic-reasoning capability and robot agility. To address this, we propose Asynchronous Robot Policy (ARP), an architectural framework that decouples semantic reasoning from low-level action generation using asynchronous processes operating at independent frequencies. In ARP, a high-capacity Vision-Language Model (VLM) asynchronously updates a semantic memory at low fre- quency, while a lightweight Vision-Action Expert, conditioned on this semantic memory, generates robot actions at a much higher control frequency. Such a formulation, enables having a fast perception-action loop without compromising on the semantic capability. To overcome asynchronous memory staleness, ARP trains the vision-action expert on the semantic staleness and execution delay, with temporally mismatched observation across processes. On Franka manipulation tasks, ARP achieves an 18% higher success rate and 20% less time need for execution in quasi-static setups, while 3-5 times baseline performance in dynamic simulation environments. Furthermore, ARP enables operating the VLM at 10 times lower than its nominal frequency with no significant performance loss making it much more efficient than the baseline. These results highlight the architectural advantages of modeling robot policies as asynchronous processes, enabling real-world reactive deployment without sacrificing the scale of foundation models.

items.title_en: Time-to-Goal: Learned Temporal Metrics for Long-Horizon Planning with JEPA World Models
items.title_zh: Time-to-Goal：面向JEPA世界模型长时程规划的学习型时间度量
items.abstract_en: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) support planning by comparing predicted latent states with an encoded goal. For this comparison to guide temporal progress, states closer in time to the goal should receive lower costs. However, training representations for prediction and distribution regularization does not directly enforce this ordering. We examine this mismatch in flat LeWorldModel (LeWM) by analyzing how its Euclidean goal cost changes with temporal separation. Our analysis identifies conditions under which states at different long offsets receive similar average costs, weakening their temporal distinction. To learn the missing ordering explicitly, we introduce Time-to-Goal (T2G), a lightweight metric trained on latent triples from offline trajectories. A margin ranking loss encourages smaller distances for temporally nearer states, requiring no rewards or policy labels. The learned metric then replaces the Euclidean planning cost while the JEPA encoder and predictor remain frozen. Diagnostics on AntMaze and FourRoom show that T2G preserves stronger temporal contrast and improves near--far ranking at long offsets. Across four navigation and manipulation benchmarks, T2G improves the average planning success rate from 32.7\% (flat LeWM) to 63.0\% and approaches or even surpasses the performance of the hierarchical H-JEPA baselines. These results show that learning temporal ordering for the goal cost can substantially improve latent planning even with a flat world model.

items.title_en: WayTrace: A Map-to-Language-to-Trace Hierarchy for Embodied Urban Navigation
items.title_zh: WayTrace：面向具身城市导航的从地图到语言再到轨迹的层级结构
items.abstract_en: Web services provide walking directions for nearly every city, but following them reliably over long routes remains challenging for autonomous robots. Point-goal navigation policies rely heavily on accurate GNSS, while most vision-language navigation models struggle to execute even short instructions outdoors. We present WayTrace, a hierarchical system that connects web-map directions to robot motion through language. An off-the-shelf orchestrator vision-language model reads the turn-by-turn directions, a satellite map and recent camera images, and issues one atomic language command at a time, such as "cross the road to the left". An onboard trace predictor, trained on over one million automatically labelled samples from street-level images, draws the path for this command in the image, and a reinforcement learning policy tracks it. In long-range simulated missions, WayTrace remains robust to GNSS noise and rarely leaves crosswalks or sidewalks, while point-goal baselines degrade sharply with about ten times more violations. Deployed on a wheeled-legged robot, WayTrace completes real-world missions of up to 1.37 km at about 1.1 m/s through a busy city centre, rural trails and a university campus, handling crosswalks, staircases and construction sites. Project page: https://way-trace.github.io

items.title_en: DexHOT: Learning Hand-Object Configuration Transfer for Dexterous Manipulation
items.title_zh: DexHOT：面向灵巧操作的手-物体构型迁移学习
items.abstract_en: Dexterous manipulation involves not only moving objects, but also arranging the hand around them to maintain useful contacts and enable subsequent actions. Yet many learning-based systems specify goals primarily through object poses or trajectories, leaving hand-object configurations to emerge implicitly. We introduce DexHOT, which formulates dexterous manipulation as hand-object configuration transfer: moving between feasible configurations that jointly specify hand articulation and object pose relative to the wrist. DexHOT learns a reusable relation-conditioned transfer primitive from synthetic feasible configuration pairs, without human reference motions, and composes long-horizon behaviors through closed-loop tracking of configuration subgoals. On DexHOTBench with 120 objects, a single policy achieves 80.5% transfer success on seen objects and 69.4% on unseen objects; on a real dexterous hand, it achieves 61.5% success over 200 real-robot transfers and 90% task success across six demonstration-guided tasks. These results show that explicit hand-object goals provide an expressive and composable interface for dexterous manipulation. More details and videos are available at https://dex-hot.github.io/.

items.title_en: Distributed Linear Bandits for Freshness-Aware Preprocessing in MEC-Enabled Digital Twin Networks
items.title_zh: 面向MEC使能数字孪生网络中新鲜度感知预处理的分布式线性老虎机
items.abstract_en: Digital twins (DTs) require timely updates from Internet of Things (IoT) devices to accurately represent the state of the corresponding physical systems, but transmitting large data volumes can compromise freshness. Moreover, different task classes have distinct computational demands and freshness requirements, while stochastic task generation and sizes complicate resource allocation. In this paper, we propose a freshness-aware framework in which multi-access edge computing (MEC) servers preprocess IoT data, reducing transmission volume and DT-server processing load. The framework establishes mutual support between DT and MEC servers. The DTs determine feasible CPU-allocation strategies guaranteeing class-specific age-of-information (AoI) requirements under specified workload, delay, and update-generation bounds. MEC servers collaboratively identify the feasible strategy minimizing expected freshness-normalized preprocessing delay. We formulate CPU-strategy selection as a fixed-confidence distributed best-arm identification problem in linear bandits, with MEC servers as agents and CPU allocations across task classes as arms. We employ DistLinGapE, a distributed collaborative learning method, to coordinate exploration and share observations. Numerical results show that the method identifies the optimal feasible strategy and reduces preprocessing delay when deployed under stationary task-class assignments and workload statistics. Collaboration yields an identification speedup nearly proportional to the number of participating MEC servers in the evaluated settings.

rm.usage: 论文面向MEC数字孪生网络的数据新鲜度与资源分配，与RoboMaster多机通信和雷达信息融合场景差异很大，基本用不上。

items.title_en: HLO-AMP: Hierarchical Loco-Manipulation from Object-Aware Motion Priors
items.title_zh: HLO-AMP：基于物体感知运动先验的分层移动-操作
items.abstract_en: Hierarchical pipelines for humanoid loco-manipulation typically pair a task-agnostic whole-body controller (WBC) with a downstream task policy. Such WBCs are often trained through manual reward shaping, which yields visibly machine-like motions; more consequentially, they are trained without the manipulated object in the scene. Object dynamics are instead approximated through randomized end-effector force disturbances, a proxy that fails to reproduce the distributed multi-contact wrench a real payload applies across the arms and torso, with the gap becoming critical near the platform's payload limit. In this work, we train the low-level (LL) controller itself as an object-aware motion prior: a single policy trained via motion imitation on retargeted motion-capture (MoCap) references that span the core motion primitives of the downstream task, with the manipulated object physically present in the scene. This single stage inherits natural human-like coordination from the references and absorbs the realistic contact wrench at its source, while exposing the same compact task-space command interface used by command-tracking WBCs. A reference-free high-level (HL) policy is then trained on top, with its action channel anchored to the empirical envelope of the low-level training data so that it generalizes the priors to a long-horizon multi-stage task while structurally preventing queries that would push the low level off-distribution. We instantiate the framework on a Unitree G1 for bimanual box pick-and-place: the same deployed policy generalizes across object masses and dimensions, initial and goal poses, and reactively recovers from intentional drops mid-carry. Video: https://youtu.be/viR_ULnRDQQ.
items.comment: Accepted at the Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL 2026). Video: https://youtu.be/viR_ULnRDQQ
